title: BPSC Stenographer Admit Card 2026: Out for 15 Posts #BPSCStenographer2026 #BiharSteno #SarkariNaukri
intro: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has Released Official Notification for the Online Application Form for the Post of Stenographer for 15 Post. Exam Held on June 11, 2026 & Admit Card Released On June 4, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Exam Date Notice Now in The Given Link Below.
importantDates: Payment Mode: Pay Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode.
Note: Candidates who do not provide their Aadhaar number as an identity proof in the online application will have to pay an additional Biometric fee of Rs.200/-
Maximum Age : 40 Years (Female UR, BC/ EBC-Male & Female)
For Age Relaxation.Read the Official Notification
Primary Requirement: 10+2 (Intermediate) or equivalent from a Recognized board.
Equivalent Qualifications:- (i) Maulvi Certificate. (ii) ITI (2-year course via NCVT/SCVT). (iii) Polytechnic Diploma (3-year Engineering)
Technical Skills: -Stenography- Hindi and English shorthand.
Computer Skills: Typing and knowledge of Basics/Word Processing.
For More Details, Read Official Notification.
Selection Process:Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Skill Test.
February 2, 2026: Last date for registration and fee payment.
Educational Qualification: 10+2 (Intermediate) or equivalent + Hindi/English Stenography & Computer Typing.
Mode of Selection: Written Exam + Skill Test
